{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: divide by 10 to convert µg/L to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Print only the numbers that will be used in evidence
print(len(df))  # Original row count
print(len(df_dedup))  # Deduplicated patient count
print(len(df) - len(df_dedup))  # Number of duplicate patient rows
print(df_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].nunique())  # Unique values after correction
print(mean_biomarker_final)  # Final mean value"}
